# 1. Behavioural Data Analysis - Study 1
```{r}
# libraries % file
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(effsize)  # for Cohen's d
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix) # also for cohen's d
library(effectsize)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
install.packages("afex")
library(afex)
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ez)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)


file <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/data_sets/Study1_Behaviour_with_Gaze_AnalysisReady.csv"

raw <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

phases <- c("LE", "ES", "EE")
excluded_subs <- c(6, 99)

raw_beh <- raw %>%
  filter(
    phase %in% phases,
    !sub_id %in% excluded_subs
  )



# Keep original physical left/right behavioural columns

data <- raw_beh %>%
  transmute(
    sub_id,
    participant_row,
    phase,
    trial,
    sess,
    cond,

    # Original option positions
    op1,
    op2,

    # Original values / probabilities
    ev1,
    ev2,
    p1,
    p2,

    # Original choice:
    # cho = 1 -> option 1 / left
    # cho = 2 -> option 2 / right
    cho,

    corr,
    rtime,
    rew,
    out,
    cfout
  )



# get chosen stimulus identity

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    chosen_stimulus = case_when(
      cho == 1 ~ op1,
      cho == 2 ~ op2,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    chose_E = case_when(
      phase == "ES" & chosen_stimulus == "E" ~ 1L,
      phase == "ES" & chosen_stimulus == "S" ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    chose_S = case_when(
      phase == "ES" & chosen_stimulus == "S" ~ 1L,
      phase == "ES" & chosen_stimulus == "E" ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )



# Safety audits

# ES trials must contain exactly one E and one S
stopifnot(
  all(
    with(
      filter(data, phase == "ES"),
      (op1 == "E" & op2 == "S") |
      (op1 == "S" & op2 == "E")
    )
  )
)

# Physical choice must map to the correct stimulus
stopifnot(
  all(
    data$chosen_stimulus[data$cho == 1] ==
      data$op1[data$cho == 1],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    data$chosen_stimulus[data$cho == 2] ==
      data$op2[data$cho == 2],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

# Compare reconstructed choices against AnalysisReady labels
# Only LE, ES and EE trials are included

n_disagreements <- sum(
  raw_beh$stim_chosen != data$chosen_stimulus,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(n_disagreements)  # Expected: 0

stopifnot(n_disagreements == 0)

# Check missing choice identities separately
sum(is.na(data$chosen_stimulus))

```

# 2. Filter phases, get mean, remove outliers, check normality
```{r}
# phases
phases<- c("LE", "ES", "EE")
excluded_subs <- c(6,99)   # exclusion of participants from behavioral data: Nr.6 stopped experiment at the start, 99 is me :); if we exclude participants due to lack of eye-tracking data, it would be 4,5,6,14     1, 4, 5, 6, 14, 99

data_filt <- data %>%
  filter(
    phase %in% phases,
    !sub_id %in% excluded_subs
  )

# mean accuracy per participant and phase
accuracy_df <- data_filt %>%
  group_by(sub_id, phase) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Accuracy = mean(corr), .groups = "drop")

# removing outliers
outliers <- accuracy_df %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  identify_outliers(Mean_Accuracy)
accuracy_df <- accuracy_df %>%
  filter(!(sub_id %in% outliers$sub_id[outliers$is.extreme]))

# normality assumption test
shapiro_results_corr <- accuracy_df %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(Shapiro_p = shapiro.test(Mean_Accuracy)$p.value)
```

# 3. Accuracy per choice problem in the LE phase

```{r}
# get the accuracy for each difficulty level in the LE phase (10/30, 20/60, 40/80, 70/90)

fig_out <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/figures/behav/Study1_Mean_Acc_LE_cond.pdf"    

learning_cond <- c(3, 2, 1, 0)

learning_acc_df <- data %>%
  filter(phase == "LE", cond %in% learning_cond, !sub_id %in% excluded_subs) %>%
  group_by(sub_id, cond) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc_LE = mean(corr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, 
                       levels = c(3, 2, 1, 0),
                       labels = c("40/60", "30/70", "20/80", "10/90")),
                       cond_num = as.numeric(cond),
                       jittered_x = cond_num + runif(n(), -0.10, 0.10))

mean_points_LE <- learning_acc_df %>%
  group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(mean_acc_LE), .groups = "drop")

cond_colors <- c(
  "40/60" = "rosybrown1",
  "30/70" = "rosybrown2",
  "20/80" = "rosybrown3",
  "10/90" = "rosybrown4"
)

learning_acc_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = learning_acc_df, aes(x = cond, y = mean_acc_LE, fill = cond),
               width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = learning_acc_df, aes(x = jittered_x, y = mean_acc_LE, group = sub_id),
            color = "black", alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_point(data = learning_acc_df, aes(x = jittered_x, y = mean_acc_LE),
             color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = mean_points_LE, aes(x = cond, y = mean_val, label = "*"),
            color = "red", size = 10, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Accuracy Across Blocks in the LE Phase",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Mean Accuracy (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray80", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black") 
)

ggsave(filename = fig_out, plot = learning_acc_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", fig_out), plot = learning_acc_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

learning_acc_plot

```

# Mean accuracy per learning block stats

```{r}
# maakign cond  factor
learning_acc_df <- learning_acc_df %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = c("40/60", "30/70", "20/80", "10/90")))

anov <- ezANOVA(
  data        = learning_acc_df,
  dv          = .(mean_acc_LE),
  wid         = .(sub_id),
  within      = .(cond),
  type        = 3,
  detailed    = TRUE     
)

print(anov)

##########################################################################
posthoc <- learning_acc_df %>%
  pairwise_t_test(
    mean_acc_LE ~ cond,
    paired         = TRUE,
    p.adjust.method = "bonferroni",
    conf.level      = 0.95,        
    detailed        = TRUE         
  )

posthoc

learning_acc_df %>%
  group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    mean_acc  = mean(mean_acc_LE),
    sd_acc    = sd(mean_acc_LE),
    sem_acc   = sd_acc / sqrt(n),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# posthoc table
posthoc_tbl <- posthoc %>%
  mutate(
    contrast  = paste(group1, "–", group2),
    estimate  = round(estimate, 2),
    statistic = round(statistic, 2),
    conf.low  = round(conf.low, 2),
    conf.high = round(conf.high, 2),
    p.adj     = round(p.adj, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(contrast, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.adj)

write.csv(
  posthoc_tbl,
  "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/Study1_table_LE.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


#stats table
desc_tbl <- learning_acc_df %>%
  group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean_acc = mean(mean_acc_LE),
    sd_acc   = sd(mean_acc_LE),
    sem_acc  = sd_acc / sqrt(n),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_acc = round(mean_acc, 2),
    sd_acc   = round(sd_acc, 2),
    sem_acc  = round(sem_acc, 2)
  )

write.csv(
  desc_tbl,
  "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/Study1_table_LE_descriptives.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Mean RT per learning block 
```{r}
learning_rt_df <- data %>% 
  filter(phase == "LE",cond %in% learning_cond,!sub_id %in% excluded_subs) %>%
  mutate(logRT = log(rtime)) %>% 
  group_by(sub_id, cond) %>% 
  summarise(mean_logRT = mean(logRT),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(cond = factor(cond,
                       levels = c(3, 2, 1, 0),
                       labels = c("40/60", "30/70", "20/80", "10/90")))

anov_rt <- ezANOVA(
  data     = learning_rt_df,
  dv       = .(mean_logRT),
  wid      = .(sub_id),
  within   = .(cond),
  type     = 3,
  detailed = TRUE
)
summary(anov_rt)

posthoc_rt <- learning_rt_df %>% 
  pairwise_t_test(
    mean_logRT ~ cond,
    paired          = TRUE,
    p.adjust.method = "bonferroni",
    conf.level      = 0.95,
    detailed        = TRUE
  )

posthoc_rt
exp(posthoc_rt$estimate)

learning_rt_df %>% 
  group_by(cond) %>% 
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    geo_meanRT = exp(mean(mean_logRT)),     # transform
    sd_logRT   = sd(mean_logRT),
    sem_logRT  = sd_logRT / sqrt(n),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )


output_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/"

# ANOVA table
write.csv(anov_rt$ANOVA, file.path(output_dir, "LE_RT_ANOVA.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

posthoc_rt_save <- posthoc_rt %>%
  mutate(
    exp_estimate = exp(estimate)
  )

write.csv(posthoc_rt_save, file.path(output_dir, "LE_RT_Posthoc_Bonferroni.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 3. Descriptive statistics
learning_rt_summary <- learning_rt_df %>% 
  group_by(cond) %>% 
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    geo_meanRT = exp(mean(mean_logRT)),
    sd_logRT   = sd(mean_logRT),
    sem_logRT  = sd_logRT / sqrt(n),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

write.csv(learning_rt_summary, file.path(output_dir, "LE_RT_Descriptives.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

print(learning_rt_summary)
print(posthoc_rt_save)
```

# 3. Accuracy (LE, ES, EE) + repeated measures ANOVA
```{r}

# summary of rmANOVA
anova_results <- accuracy_df %>%
  anova_test(dv = Mean_Accuracy, wid = sub_id, within = phase)
anova_table <- get_anova_table(anova_results)

#phase + colour
accuracy_df <- accuracy_df %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("LE", "ES", "EE")))

phase_colors <- c("EE" = "deepskyblue4", "ES" = "darkorchid4", "LE" = "rosybrown4")

plot_df <- accuracy_df %>%
  group_by(sub_id, phase) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Accuracy = mean(Mean_Accuracy), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    phase_num = as.numeric(factor(phase, levels = c("LE", "ES", "EE"))),
    jittered_x = phase_num + runif(n(), -0.1, 0.1)

# asterisks

    names_from = phase,
    values_from = Mean_Accuracy
  )

  wide_df$LE,
  wide_df$ES,
  paired = TRUE
)

d_LE_EE <- effectsize::cohens_d(
  wide_df$LE,
  wide_df$EE,
  paired = TRUE
)

d_ES_EE <- effectsize::cohens_d(
  wide_df$ES,
  wide_df$EE,
  paired = TRUE
)


#table
effect_sizes <- bind_rows(
  
  as.data.frame(d_LE_ES) %>%
    mutate(Comparison = "LE vs ES"),
  
  as.data.frame(d_LE_EE) %>%
    mutate(Comparison = "LE vs EE"),
  
  as.data.frame(d_ES_EE) %>%
    mutate(Comparison = "ES vs EE")
  
) %>%
  select(
    Comparison,
    everything()
  )

write.csv(effect_sizes, file.path(output_dir, "Study1_Accuracy_Phase_EffectSizes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Accuracy comparison between ES and EE

```{r}

output_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/figures/behav/"
results_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/"

phase_colors <- c("ES" = "darkorchid4", "EE" = "deepskyblue4")

# Participant-level accuracy in ES and EE
plot_df <- accuracy_df %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("ES", "EE"), !is.na(Mean_Accuracy)) %>%
  group_by(sub_id, phase) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Accuracy = mean(Mean_Accuracy), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sub_id) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("ES", "EE")))

# Group means, SD and 95% confidence intervals
accuracy_summary <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_accuracy = mean(Mean_Accuracy),
    sd_accuracy = sd(Mean_Accuracy),
    ci_low = t.test(Mean_Accuracy)$conf.int[1],
    ci_high = t.test(Mean_Accuracy)$conf.int[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Paired t-test and effect size
wide_df <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = phase, values_from = Mean_Accuracy)

accuracy_test <- t.test(wide_df$ES, wide_df$EE, paired = TRUE)
effect_size <- effectsize::cohens_d(wide_df$ES, wide_df$EE, paired = TRUE)

# Consistent participant jitter across phases
set.seed(123)
offsets <- tibble(sub_id = wide_df$sub_id,
                  offset = runif(nrow(wide_df), -0.1, 0.1))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(offsets, by = "sub_id") %>%
  mutate(phase_num = as.numeric(phase),
         jittered_x = phase_num + offset)

# Boxplot
accuracy_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = plot_df,
               aes(x = phase_num, y = Mean_Accuracy, fill = phase, group = phase),
               width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_line(data = plot_df,
            aes(x = jittered_x, y = Mean_Accuracy, group = sub_id),
            color = "black", alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_point(data = plot_df,
             aes(x = jittered_x, y = Mean_Accuracy),
             color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = accuracy_summary,
            aes(x = as.numeric(phase), y = mean_accuracy, label = "*"),
            color = "red", size = 10, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phase_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:2, labels = c("ES", "EE")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.4, 1, 0.2),
                     labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.4, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Accuracy",
       x = "Phase", y = "Accuracy (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),

# ES vs EE accuracy: trial-level binomial GLMM

results_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/"

acc_trials <- data_filt %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("ES", "EE"), !is.na(corr)) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("EE", "ES")))

# keep participants represented in both phases
valid_subs <- acc_trials %>%
  distinct(sub_id, phase) %>%
  count(sub_id, name = "n_phases") %>%
  filter(n_phases == 2) %>%
  pull(sub_id)

acc_trials <- acc_trials %>% filter(sub_id %in% valid_subs)
stopifnot(all(acc_trials$corr %in% c(0, 1)))

# trial-level accuracy model
acc_glmm <- glmer(
  corr ~ phase + (1 | sub_id),
  data = acc_trials,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

# model-estimated accuracy by phase
acc_emm <- emmeans(acc_glmm, ~ phase)

# ES vs EE: log-odds contrast, odds ratio and 95% CI
acc_contrast <- contrast(acc_emm, list("ES / EE" = c(-1, 1)))

acc_probabilities <- summary(acc_emm, type = "response",
                             infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
acc_comparison <- summary(acc_contrast, type = "response",
                          infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))

# save full results
capture.output({
  cat("study 1: ES vs EE accuracy - binomial GLMM\n\n")
  cat("participants:", n_distinct(acc_trials$sub_id), "\n")
  cat("trials:", nrow(acc_trials), "\n\n")
  cat("trials per phase\n")
  print(count(acc_trials, phase))

  cat("\nmodel: corr ~ phase + (1 | sub_id)\n")
  print(summary(acc_glmm))

  cat("\nmodel-estimated accuracy (95% CI)\n")
  print(acc_probabilities)

  cat("\nES vs EE: odds ratio (95% CI)\n")
  print(acc_comparison)

  cat("\nmodel diagnostics\n")
  cat("singular fit:", isSingular(acc_glmm), "\n")
}, file = file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Accuracy_ES_EE_GLMM.txt"))

write.csv(as.data.frame(acc_comparison),
          file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Accuracy_ES_EE_GLMM_Contrast.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# 5. Above chance performance ? 

```{r}
phases<- c("LE", "ES", "EE")
excluded_subs <- c(6,99)   # exclusion of participants from behavioral data only (not eye-trcking). Nr.6 stopped experiment at the start, 99 is me; if we exclude participants due to lack of eye-tracking data, it would be 4,5,6,14

data_filt <- data %>%
  filter(phase %in% phases & !sub_id %in% excluded_subs)

# mean accuracy per participant and phase
accuracy_df <- data_filt %>%
  group_by(sub_id, phase) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Accuracy = mean(corr), .groups = "drop")
accuracy_df <- accuracy_df %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("LE", "ES", "EE")))

# One-sample t-tests for each phase against chance level
t_test_results <- accuracy_df %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(Mean_Accuracy),
    se = sd(Mean_Accuracy) / sqrt(n()),
    t_statistic = t.test(Mean_Accuracy, mu = 0.5)$statistic,
    df = t.test(Mean_Accuracy, mu = 0.5)$parameter,
    p_value = t.test(Mean_Accuracy, mu = 0.5)$p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "n.s."
    )
  )
print(t_test_results)

write.csv(t_test_results, file.path(output_dir, "Study1_Accuracy_AboveChance_OneSampleTTests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Additional lmer with log transformed RT

```{r}
# RT across phases:
# participant-level Wilcoxon + trial-level LMM

output_file <- paste0("D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/Study1_RT_Phase_AllResults.txt")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Participant-level Wilcoxon tests

wilcoxon_results <- rt_df %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Mean_RT ~ phase,
    paired = TRUE,
    p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Trial-level RT data

rt_outlier_subs <- outliers %>%
  filter(is.extreme) %>%
  pull(sub_id) %>%
  unique()

rt_trials <- data_filt %>%
  filter(
    phase %in% c("LE", "ES", "EE"),
    !sub_id %in% rt_outlier_subs,
    !is.na(rtime),
    rtime > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c("LE", "ES", "EE")
    ),
    logRT = log(rtime)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# linear mixed model - trial level


lme_model <- lmer(logRT ~ phase + (1 | sub_id), data = rt_trials)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Estimated  means + Bonferroni comparisons + satterthwaite with limit

emm_results <- emmeans(lme_model, ~ phase, lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = nrow(rt_trials) + 1)

emm_pairwise <- pairs(
  emm_results,
  adjust = "bonferroni"
)

emm_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    emm_results,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  )
)

# find whichever CI names emmeans has
ci_low  <- if ("lower.CL" %in% names(emm_table)) "lower.CL" else "asymp.LCL"
ci_high <- if ("upper.CL" %in% names(emm_table)) "upper.CL" else "asymp.UCL"

emm_table <- emm_table %>%
  mutate(
    geometric_mean_RT_seconds = exp(emmean),
    CI_low_seconds  = exp(.data[[ci_low]]),
    CI_high_seconds = exp(.data[[ci_high]])
  )


# pairwise phase comparisons
pairwise_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    emm_pairwise,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  )
)

ci_low_pair  <- if ("lower.CL" %in% names(pairwise_table)) "lower.CL" else "asymp.LCL"
ci_high_pair <- if ("upper.CL" %in% names(pairwise_table)) "upper.CL" else "asymp.UCL"

pairwise_table <- pairwise_table %>%
  mutate(
    RT_ratio = exp(estimate),
    ratio_CI_low  = exp(.data[[ci_low_pair]]),
    ratio_CI_high = exp(.data[[ci_high_pair]])
  )


# save everything to one text file
output_file <- paste0("D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/Study1_RT_Phase_AllResults.txt")

capture.output({

  cat("Study 1 - reaction time across LE, ES, and EE\n")
  cat("============================================================\n\n")

  cat("Sample information\n")
  cat("------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  cat("Number of trial-level observations:", nrow(rt_trials), "\n")
  cat("Number of participants:", n_distinct(rt_trials$sub_id), "\n")
  cat(
    "Participants removed as extreme RT outliers:",
    paste(rt_outlier_subs, collapse = ", "),
    "\n\n"
  )

  cat("Participant-level Wilcoxon tests\n")
  cat("Bonferroni corrected\n")
  cat("------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  print(wilcoxon_results)

  cat("\n\nTrial-level linear mixed model\n")
  cat("Outcome: log reaction time\n")
  cat("Model: logRT ~ phase + (1 | sub_id)\n")
  cat("------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  print(summary(lme_model))

  cat("\n\nEstimated marginal means\n")
  cat("Geometric mean RTs are back-transformed to seconds\n")
  cat("------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  print(emm_table)

  cat("\n\nPairwise phase comparisons\n")
  cat("Bonferroni corrected\n")
  cat("RT ratio = exponentiated log-RT difference\n")
  cat("------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  print(pairwise_table)

}, file = output_file)

```

# Glmer Accuracy E vs S choices (ES phase)
```{r}

# trial-level data for ES phase
es_data_glm <- es_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(corr)) %>%
  mutate(choice_type = factor(choice_type, levels = c("S", "E")))

# logistic mixed model
m1 <- glmer(corr ~ choice_type + (1 | sub_id),data = es_data_glm,family = binomial(link = "logit"),control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

summary(m1)
```

```{r}
output_file <- paste0("D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/Study1_ES_RT_EvsS_AllResults.txt")

es_data <- data_filt %>%

    !is.na(rtime),
    rtime > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    choice_type = factor(
      chosen_stimulus,
      levels = c("S", "E")
    ),
    logRT = log(rtime)
  )



#  mean RTs for descriptives and plot

rtime_es <- es_data %>%
  group_by(sub_id, choice_type) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_rtime = mean(rtime, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_logRT = mean(logRT, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# participant-level paired t-test
# explicitly pair participants
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rtime_wide <- rtime_es %>%
  select(sub_id, choice_type, Mean_logRT) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = sub_id,
    names_from = choice_type,
    values_from = Mean_logRT
  ) %>%
  drop_na(E, S)

test_rtime <- t.test(
  rtime_wide$E,
  rtime_wide$S,
  paired = TRUE
)


# trial-level mixed model
# every row here is an individual ES trial

lmer_model <- lmer(logRT ~ choice_type + (1 | sub_id), data = es_data)

summary(lmer_model)


# estimated marginal means and E vs S comparison

emm_choice <- emmeans(lmer_model, ~ choice_type)

emm_pairwise <- pairs(emm_choice)


# back-transform model-estimated log RTs into seconds
emm_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    emm_choice,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  )
)

ci_low  <- if ("lower.CL" %in% names(emm_table)) "lower.CL" else "asymp.LCL"
ci_high <- if ("upper.CL" %in% names(emm_table)) "upper.CL" else "asymp.UCL"

emm_table <- emm_table %>%
  mutate(
    geometric_mean_rt = exp(emmean),
    ci_low_seconds = exp(.data[[ci_low]]),
    ci_high_seconds = exp(.data[[ci_high]])
  )


# back-transform E-S contrast into an RT ratio
pairwise_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    emm_pairwise,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  )
)

ci_low_pair  <- if ("lower.CL" %in% names(pairwise_table)) "lower.CL" else "asymp.LCL"
ci_high_pair <- if ("upper.CL" %in% names(pairwise_table)) "upper.CL" else "asymp.UCL"

pairwise_table <- pairwise_table %>%
  mutate(
    rt_ratio = exp(estimate),
    ratio_ci_low = exp(.data[[ci_low_pair]]),
    ratio_ci_high = exp(.data[[ci_high_pair]])
  )
```

# ES - p(E vs S) per rtime bin quintile

```{r}

file <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/data_sets/Study1_Behaviour_with_Gaze_AnalysisReady.csv"
output_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/figures/behav/"
results_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/"

excluded_subs <- c(6,99)   #1, 4, 5,14,

# participant rt quintiles

rt_dat <- read.csv(file) %>%
  filter(phase == "ES", !sub_id %in% excluded_subs, !is.na(sub_id),
         between(rtime, 0.250, 10), !is.na(chose_E), !is.na(chose_S)) %>%
  group_by(sub_id) %>%
  mutate(rtime_bin = ntile(rtime, 5)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rtime_bin = factor(rtime_bin, levels = 1:5,
                           labels = c("0-20%", "20-40%", "40-60%",
                                      "60-80%", "80-100%")),
         sub_id = factor(sub_id))

stopifnot(all(rt_dat$chose_E + rt_dat$chose_S == 1))



# participant means and sem

agg <- rt_dat %>%
  group_by(sub_id, rtime_bin) %>%
  summarise(p_E = mean(chose_E), p_S = mean(chose_S), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(p_E, p_S), names_to = "Choice", values_to = "prob") %>%
  mutate(Choice = factor(Choice, levels = c("p_E", "p_S"),
                         labels = c("E", "S")))

summary_df <- agg %>%
  group_by(rtime_bin, Choice) %>%
  summarise(mean_prob = mean(prob), sem = sd(prob) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")


# glmm: rt quintiles and e vs s choice

control <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")

model_null <- glmer(chose_E ~ 1 + (1 | sub_id),
                    data = rt_dat, family = binomial, control = control)

model <- glmer(chose_E ~ rtime_bin + (1 | sub_id),
               data = rt_dat, family = binomial, control = control)

rt_overall <- anova(model_null, model, test = "Chisq")

emm <- emmeans(model, ~ rtime_bin)
rt_probs <- as.data.frame(summary(emm, type = "response"))

# e vs s within each bin, holm corrected
rt_tests <- as.data.frame(test(emm, null = 0, adjust = "none")) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"),
         significance = case_when(
           p_holm < .001 ~ "***",
           p_holm < .01 ~ "**",
           p_holm < .05 ~ "*",
           TRUE ~ ""
         ))

print(rt_overall)
print(rt_probs)
print(rt_tests)


# plot

  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_prob - sem, ymax = mean_prob + sem),

  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("E" = "deepskyblue", "S" = "darkorchid"),
    name = "Chosen option"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "E vs S Choice by RT Quintile",
    x = "RT quintile (shortest to longest)",
    y = "Probability (%)"
  ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0.3, 0.7, 0.1),
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.30, 0.70)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.90),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18)
  )

print(p)



fig_base <- file.path(output_dir, "ES_RT_ChoiceQuintiles")

ggsave(paste0(fig_base, ".pdf"), p, width = 5.5, height = 4, bg = "white")
ggsave(paste0(fig_base, ".png"), p, width = 5.5, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

capture.output({
  cat("ES: choice by rt quintile\n\n")

  cat("sample\n")
  print(rt_dat %>% summarise(trials = n(), participants = n_distinct(sub_id)))

  cat("\nparticipant-level descriptives (mean +/- sem)\n")
  print(summary_df)

  cat("\noverall rt-quintile effect\n")
  print(rt_overall)

  cat("\nglmm summary\n")
  print(summary(model))

  cat("\nmodel-estimated choice probabilities\n")
  print(rt_probs)

  cat("\nE vs S within rt quintiles (holm corrected)\n")
  print(rt_tests)

}, file = file.path(results_dir, "ES_RT_ChoiceQuintiles_Results.txt"))
```

# Value Sensitivity calculations in ES,EE,SP - simialr to Garcia et al. (2023)

```{r}

file <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/data_sets/Study1_Behaviour_with_Gaze_AnalysisReady.csv"
output_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/figures/behav/"
results_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/"

excluded_subs <- c(6,99)
phase_cols <- c("ES" = "darkorchid4", "EE" = "deepskyblue4", "SP" = "deeppink4")


data <- read.csv(file) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sub_id), !sub_id %in% excluded_subs)

es <- data %>%
  filter(phase == "ES", is.finite(p_E), is.finite(p_S),
         chose_E %in% 0:1, chose_S %in% 0:1)

ee <- data %>%
  filter(phase == "EE", is.finite(p1), is.finite(p2),
         p1 != p2, cho %in% 1:2)

sp <- data %>%
  filter(phase == "SP", op1 == "E",
         is.finite(p1), is.finite(cho), between(cho, 0, 1))

stopifnot(
  setequal(unique(es$sub_id), unique(ee$sub_id)),
  setequal(unique(es$sub_id), unique(sp$sub_id)),
  all(es$chose_E + es$chose_S == 1)
)


# estimate indifference points from ES and EE choices

fit_indifference <- function(d) {

  values <- sort(unique(d$assessed))
  option <- match(d$assessed, values)

  # logistic choice function:
  # probability of choosing the assessed experiential option
  negative_loglik <- function(par) {
    beta <- exp(par[1])
    midpoint <- par[-1]

    log_odds <- beta * (midpoint[option] - d$alternative)

    -sum(ifelse(d$chosen == 1,
                plogis(log_odds, log.p = TRUE),
                plogis(-log_odds, log.p = TRUE)))
  }

  # estimate one beta and one midpoint per experiential option
  fit <- nlminb(
    start = c(0, values),
    objective = negative_loglik,
    lower = c(-Inf, rep(0, length(values))),
    upper = c(Inf, rep(1, length(values)))
  )

  tibble(
    p_E = values,
    midpoint = fit$par[-1],
    beta = exp(fit$par[1]),
    converged = fit$convergence == 0
  )
}

# ES: experiential option versus symbolic option
es_mid <- es %>%
  transmute(sub_id, assessed = p_E, alternative = p_S, chosen = chose_E) %>%
  group_by(sub_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_indifference(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(phase = "ES")

# EE: experiential option versus another experiential option
ee_mid <- ee %>%
  transmute(sub_id, assessed = p1, alternative = p2,
            chosen = as.integer(cho == 1)) %>%
  group_by(sub_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_indifference(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(phase = "EE")

fit_mid <- bind_rows(es_mid, ee_mid)


# calculate ES and EE slopes

choice_slopes <- fit_mid %>%
  group_by(sub_id, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    slope = unname(coef(lm(midpoint ~ p_E))[2]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# calculate SP slopes

sp_values <- sp %>%
  group_by(sub_id, p_E = p1) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(cho), .groups = "drop")

sp_slopes <- sp_values %>%
  group_by(sub_id) %>%
  summarise(
    slope = unname(coef(lm(value ~ p_E))[2]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(phase = "SP")


# combine phases and check fits

slope_data <- bind_rows(choice_slopes, sp_slopes) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("ES", "EE", "SP")))

fit_check <- fit_mid %>%
  group_by(sub_id, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    converged = all(converged),
    beta = first(beta),
    boundary_midpoints = sum(midpoint %in% c(0, 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(all(is.finite(slope_data$slope)),
          nrow(slope_data) == 3 * n_distinct(es$sub_id))

print(fit_check)
print(slope_data)

# save
write.csv(fit_mid, file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_FittedMidpoints.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(slope_data, file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_ParticipantSlopes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sp_values, file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_SP_E_Ratings.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(fit_check, file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_FitDiagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


```

# Comparison of the fitted value-sensitivity slopes across ES, EE and SP - this uses results saved by the fitting analysis above 

```{r}

file <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/data_sets/Study1_Behaviour_with_Gaze_AnalysisReady.csv"
output_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/figures/behav/"
results_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/"
phase_cols <- c("ES" = "darkorchid4", "EE" = "deepskyblue4", "SP" = "deeppink4")

# One previously fitted slope per participant and phase
slopes <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_ParticipantSlopes.csv")) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("ES", "EE", "SP")))

paired <- slopes %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = phase, values_from = slope) %>%
  drop_na(ES, EE, SP)
slopes <- slopes %>% semi_join(paired, by = "sub_id")

# group means and 95% confidence intervals
summary_slopes <- slopes %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_slope = mean(slope),
    sd_slope = sd(slope),
    ci_low = t.test(slope)$conf.int[1],
    ci_high = t.test(slope)$conf.int[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Paired phase comparisons
phase_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(list(c("ES", "EE"), c("ES", "SP"), c("EE", "SP")), function(ph) {
  difference <- paired[[ph[1]]] - paired[[ph[2]]]
  tt <- t.test(difference)
  tibble(comparison = paste(ph, collapse = " - "), mean_difference = mean(difference),
         ci_low = tt$conf.int[1], ci_high = tt$conf.int[2],
         t = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter), p = tt$p.value,
         cohen_dz = mean(difference) / sd(difference))
}) %>% mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))

# Do the slopes differ from 1 (the identity-line benchmark)?
identity_tests <- slopes %>% group_by(phase) %>% group_modify(~ {
  tt <- t.test(.x$slope, mu = 1)
  tibble(t = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter), p = tt$p.value)
}) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))

# Mean slope for each phase (red asterisks)
mean_points <- slopes %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(slope), .groups = "drop")

# Small horizontal offsets, consistent across phases for each participant
set.seed(123)
offsets <- tibble(
  sub_id = paired$sub_id,
  offset = runif(nrow(paired), -0.1, 0.1)
)

plot_slopes <- slopes %>%
  left_join(offsets, by = "sub_id") %>%
  mutate(
    x = as.numeric(phase),
    jittered_x = x + offset
  )

# Boxplots with individual observations and paired connections
p_slopes <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray55") +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = plot_slopes,
    aes(x = x, y = slope, fill = phase, group = phase),
    width = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_slopes,
    aes(x = jittered_x, y = slope, group = sub_id),
    color = "black", alpha = 0.05
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_slopes,
    aes(x = jittered_x, y = slope),
    color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = mean_points,
    aes(x = as.numeric(phase), y = mean_val, label = "*"),
    size = 13, color = "red"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phase_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("ES", "EE", "SP")) +
  labs(
    title = "Value Sensitivity",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Value-sensitivity slope"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_slopes)

# Save figures
fig_out <- file.path(output_dir, "Study1_Garcia_PhaseSlopes.pdf")

ggsave(fig_out, p_slopes, width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave(sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", fig_out),
       p_slopes, width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)
# Save statistical results

capture.output({
  cat("Study 1: Value-sensitivity slopes across phases\n\n")
  cat("Participants:", nrow(paired), "\n\n")
  cat("Descriptive statistics (mean, SD, 95% CI)\n")
  print(summary_slopes)
  cat("\nPaired phase comparisons (Holm-corrected)\n")
  print(phase_tests)
  cat("\nOne-sample tests against slope = 1 (Holm-corrected)\n")
  print(identity_tests)
}, file = file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_PhaseSlopes_Results.txt"))

write.csv(
  phase_tests,
  file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_PhaseSlopes_Pairwise.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# ES choice curves

```{r}

file <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/data_sets/Study1_Behaviour_with_Gaze_AnalysisReady.csv"
output_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/figures/behav/"
results_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/"
excluded_subs <- c(6, 99)

# Observed probability of choosing E for each E-S combination
es <- read.csv(file) %>%
  filter(
    phase == "ES",
    !is.na(sub_id),
    !sub_id %in% excluded_subs,
    is.finite(p_E),
    is.finite(p_S),
    chose_E %in% 0:1
  )

choice_curves <- es %>%
  group_by(sub_id, p_E, p_S) %>%
  summarise(p_choose_E = mean(chose_E), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(p_E, p_S) %>%
  summarise(probability = mean(p_choose_E), .groups = "drop")


# Find where each observed choice curve crosses 50%

find_indifference <- function(d) {

  d <- arrange(d, p_S)
  x <- d$p_S
  y <- d$probability

  # Identify segments that cross the 50% choice line
  i <- which(
    (head(y, -1) - 0.5) * (tail(y, -1) - 0.5) <= 0 &
      head(y, -1) != tail(y, -1)
  )

  # Calculate the exact intersection on each segment
  crossing <- x[i] +
    (0.5 - y[i]) * (x[i + 1] - x[i]) / (y[i + 1] - y[i])

  tibble(midpoint = unique(crossing))
}

indifference <- choice_curves %>%
  group_by(p_E) %>%
  group_modify(~ find_indifference(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check that every E-option has exactly one crossing
stopifnot(
  nrow(indifference) == n_distinct(choice_curves$p_E),
  all(table(indifference$p_E) == 1)
)


# darker colours indicate higher E probabilities
e_levels <- sort(unique(es$p_E))
e_labels <- paste0(round(100 * e_levels), "%")

orange_cols <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(c("#fee6ce", "#e6550d"))(length(e_levels)),
  e_labels
)

choice_curves <- choice_curves %>%
  mutate(e_level = factor(paste0(round(100 * p_E), "%"),
                          levels = e_labels))

indifference <- indifference %>%
  mutate(e_level = factor(paste0(round(100 * p_E), "%"),
                          levels = e_labels))


# Plot observed curves and their 50% intersections
p_choice <- ggplot(choice_curves,
                   aes(x = p_S, y = probability, color = e_level)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray45") +
  geom_line(aes(group = e_level), linewidth = 1.7) +
  geom_point(
    data = indifference,
    aes(x = midpoint, y = 0.5, color = e_level),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = orange_cols, name = "E-option p(win)") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "ES Choice Curves",
    x = "S-option p(win)",
    y = "P(choose E)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_choice)


# Save figure
fig_out <- file.path(output_dir, "Study1_Garcia_ES_ChoiceCurves.pdf")

ggsave(fig_out, p_choice, width = 6.5, height = 4, bg = "white")
ggsave(sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", fig_out),
       p_choice, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")


# Save empirical indifference points and descriptive information
capture.output({
  cat("Study 1: ES choice curves and empirical indifference points\n\n")
  cat("Participants:", n_distinct(es$sub_id), "\n")
  cat("Trials:", nrow(es), "\n\n")
  cat("Intersections of observed group choice curves with P(choose E) = 0.50\n")
  print(indifference %>% select(p_E, midpoint))

}, file = file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_ES_ChoiceCurves_Results.txt"))

write.csv(
  indifference,
  file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_ES_EmpiricalIndifferencePoints.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

# ES, EE, SP value functions (ES,EE are estimated indifference probs from choices; SP are stated prob. ratings of experiential options)


```{r}
# dashed line is teh objective prob. and teh coloured solid lines are linear fits to the mean values

file <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/data_sets/Study1_Behaviour_with_Gaze_AnalysisReady.csv"
output_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/figures/behav/"
results_dir <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/"

phase_cols <- c("ES" = "darkorchid4", "EE" = "deepskyblue4", "SP" = "deeppink4")

# Use the estimates generated by your first analysis (no re-fitting).
midpoints <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_FittedMidpoints.csv"))
sp_ratings <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_SP_E_Ratings.csv"))

values <- bind_rows(
  midpoints %>% transmute(sub_id, phase, p_E, value = midpoint),
  sp_ratings %>% transmute(sub_id, phase = "SP", p_E, value)
) %>% mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("ES", "EE", "SP")))

# All three phases must have the same participant sample and E probability levels.
coverage <- values %>% count(sub_id, phase)
stopifnot(n_distinct(coverage$phase) == 3,
          all(coverage$n == 8),
          nrow(coverage) == 3 * n_distinct(values$sub_id))

# Participant-averaged values and 95% confidence intervals.
value_summary <- values %>%
  group_by(phase, p_E) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_value = mean(value),
    sd_value = sd(value),
    ci_low = t.test(value)$conf.int[1],
    ci_high = t.test(value)$conf.int[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot mean experiential value estimates across phases

p_values <- ggplot(value_summary, aes(p_E, mean_value, color = phase)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray55") +
  geom_line(aes(group = phase), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                width = .015, linewidth = .7) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = phase_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, .2), labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, .2), labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Experiential Value Estimates",
       x = "Objective E-option P(win)", y = " Estimated P(win)", color = "Phase") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_values)

fig_out <- file.path(output_dir, "Study1_Garcia_ES_EE_SP_ValueFunctions.pdf")
ggsave(fig_out, p_values, width = 6, height = 6, bg = "white")
ggsave(sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", fig_out), p_values,
       width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

capture.output({
  cat("study 1: value estimates across es, ee and sp\n\n")
  cat("participants:", n_distinct(values$sub_id), "\n\n")
  cat("es and ee: estimated indifference points; sp: stated experiential ratings\n\n")
  cat("Descriptive Statistics (mean,sd,95% ci\n")
  print(value_summary)
}, file = file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_ES_EE_SP_ValueFunctions_Results.txt"))

write.csv(value_summary,
          file.path(results_dir, "Study1_Garcia_ES_EE_SP_ValueFunctions.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

```
